2607.02360.title: GAP-GDRNet: Geometry-Aware Monocular Visual Pose Sensing on a Single-Target Synthetic Spacecraft Dataset
2607.02360.paper_summary: Monocular relative pose sensing is a central perception problem in non-cooperative rendezvous and on-orbit servicing. In spacecraft images, however, weak surface texture, thin appendages, illumination changes, and partial occlusion often leave only sparse and unstable geometric evidence. This article presents GAP-GDRNet, a geometry-aware attention-enhanced framework for monocular RGB-based 6D pose sensing. The method follows the geometry-guided direct regression paradigm of GDR-Net and modifies two points in the pipeline: an attention-based feature refinement (AFR) module is placed before dense geometric prediction, and a patch-level geometric self-attention (PGSA) module is inserted into Patch-PnP. AFR reinforces global spacecraft structure together with local weak-texture cues; PGSA then relates downsampled geometric patches before final pose regression. A Blender-based annotation process supplies target masks, visible-region masks, dense model-coordinate maps, camera intrinsics, and 6D pose labels for supervised training.
2607.02360.paper_summary_zh: 單目相對姿態感知是非合作會合和在軌服務中的一個核心感知問題。然而，在太空船影像中，弱表面紋理、細長附屬物、光照變化和部分遮擋常常僅留下稀疏且不穩定的幾何證據。本文提出了GAP-GDRNet，一種幾何感知的注意力增強框架，用於基於單目RGB的6D姿態感知。該方法遵循GDR-Net的幾何引導直接回歸範式，並在流程中修改了兩個點：在密集幾何預測之前放置了一個基於注意力的特徵精煉（AFR）模塊，並在Patch-PnP中插入了一個基於補丁的幾何自注意力（PGSA）模塊。AFR強化了全球太空船結構以及局部弱紋理線索；然後，PGSA在最終姿態回歸之前關聯下採樣的幾何補丁。一個基於Blender的標註過程提供了目標遮罩、可見區域遮罩、密集模型坐標圖、相機內部參數和6D姿態標籤，以進行監督訓練。
2607.02360.author: Yonglong Zhang et.al.
